summary:
Your legs stay too straight on the forehand topspin, so your arm does the work instead of your legs and waist.

**What was made:** A highlight reel of your top 5 rallies by shot count, from 18 rallies found (the longest is 13 shots). Your closest pros are Ma Long (84% match), Fan Zhendong (77%) and Sun Yingsha (76%). I read your bat hand as right from the paddle colour across several rallies.

**What to work on first:**
1. Bend your knees more. At contact your knee angle is 157°. Fan Zhendong is 31° more bent, and Ma Long's forehand knee is 126°. Aim for about 125-135°. At the finish your legs are 18° straighter than Ma Long's.
2. Open your elbow a little less. Your elbow at contact is 128°, which is 16° straighter than Fan Zhendong's by the app's comparison. Keep it relaxed and let the body turn drive the swing.
3. Load lower in the backswing. Your legs are 14° straighter than Sun Yingsha's, and your bat arm is 13° higher. Drop the bat and sit into the legs first.

**Keep:** Your contact is out in front of the body, and your finish is high and across. Your stance is about 1.77 shoulder widths at contact, which is stable.

**Drill:** Do shadow forehands in front of a mirror. Start with your knees bent to about 130°, brush low to high, and freeze at the finish. Do 3 sets of 15.

breakdown.headline: Sit Lower, Drive From Legs
breakdown.grip: Relaxed shakehand: keep the index finger loose on the blade so the wrist can brush over the ball.
breakdown.stance: Feet about 1.8 shoulder widths apart, but your knees are too straight at 157°. Aim for about 125-135° and lean the chest slightly forward.
breakdown.swing_path: Start the bat lower and behind the hip, then swing low to high. Your backswing arm is 13° higher than Sun Yingsha's.
breakdown.contact_point: Contact in front of your body at the top of the bounce, with the elbow near 128° and relaxed.
breakdown.follow_through: Finish high toward the forehead, then recover quickly to ready with the knees still bent.

steps.title: LOAD LOWER
lines: Bend knees and drop the bat behind your hip

steps.title: BRUSH FORWARD
lines: Meet the ball in front at the top of bounce
A relaxed elbow gives a smooth brush and spin

steps.title: FINISH HIGH
lines: Rise through the legs and end near your head
Legs and waist power the lift; then reset low

breakdown.recap: Load lower, brush forward in front, finish high and reset with bent knees.
breakdown.drill: Shadow forehands in a mirror: start with knees at about 130°, brush low to high, freeze at the finish for 2 seconds, 3 sets of 15.
